packageRules.description: Compose — every androidx.compose.* artifact is pinned by the BOM (versions.composeBom in gradle/libs.versions.toml); the member libraries carry no version of their own.
Hilt/Dagger — the Gradle plugin, hilt-android and hilt-android-compiler all resolve from versions.hilt and MUST land in one PR; a split version fails the build.
androidx.hilt (hilt-navigation-compose, hilt-work, hilt-compiler) — versions.androidxHilt, released independently of Dagger/Hilt above.

Kotlin + KSP — versions.ksp is Kotlin-derived (<kotlin>-<ksp>) and the Compose compiler plugin ships in the Kotlin release, so all three move together. Patterns deliberately require ':' or '.' after 'kotlin' so org.jetbrains.kotlinx (coroutines) does NOT fall in here.
Room — runtime, ktx, compiler and testing all resolve from versions.room.
Lifecycle — viewmodel-compose and runtime-compose resolve from versions.lifecycle.
CameraX — camera2, lifecycle and view resolve from versions.camerax.
Coroutines — kotlinx-coroutines-android and -test resolve from versions.coroutines.
Android Gradle Plugin — application and library plugins resolve from versions.agp.
